name: 브란드
silhouette: 낮고 긴 족제비 형태, 뾰족한 주둥이, 길게 뻗은 꼬리, 날카로운 발톱 실루엣
signature_motion: 지면을 낮게 깔며 빠르게 대각선으로 돌진하는 움직임
signature_vfx: 돌진 경로를 따라 남는 에메랄드빛 잔상
visual_en: A low-profile, elongated weasel-like creature facing right. The body is covered in bright orange fur that stands out against dark backgrounds. It has a sharp, pointed snout with a small cream-white dot on the nose and glowing emerald green eyes. A thin, flexible tail extends backward. Around its neck, a small bone accessory is visible. The creature wears minimal teal leather guards on its front limbs, featuring a fine cream-colored trim. Its sharp, clawed paws are poised for a sudden spring.
features_en: Low and long weasel body type
pose_en: Crouched low to the ground, ready to spring forward instantly.
vfx_en: A swift streak of emerald green light following the dash path.
